ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the following figure, “Spatial Distribution Map of the Comprehensive Industrial Belts in Western China.” <image1> The industrial belts in the region shown in the figure are distributed in long strips. What is the most important reason causing this phenomenon?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the comprehensive industrial belts in western China are represented by black or shaded patches. Overall, they are not spread out evenly over a large area, but are distributed in a slender, bead-string-like pattern. For example, in the north they extend along the northern foot of the Tianshan Mountains and near the Lanxin Line; in the middle they form a belt in directions such as Lanzhou—Guanzhong; in the southwest they extend along directions such as Chengdu—Chongqing—Guiyang—Kunming. The figure also marks multiple transport trunk lines, such as the Lanxin Line, the Longhai Line, the Baoji-Chengdu Railway, the Chengdu-Kunming Railway, the Sichuan-Guizhou Line, the Guiyang-Kunming Line, etc. Then reason: The extension directions of these industrial belts are basically consistent with the directions of major transport trunk lines such as railways, indicating that the industrial layout mainly develops by relying on transport lines. Therefore, the most important reason why the industrial belts are distributed in a long-strip shape is the direction of the main transport lines.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出综合产业带的形态和位置：黑色或阴影产业带呈细长串珠状，沿乌鲁木齐—哈密、兰州—西宁/银川、成都—重庆—贵阳—昆明等方向延伸。再读图中与这些产业带相邻或重合的交通线标注，如兰新线、陇海线、宝成铁路、成昆铁路、川黔线、贵昆线等。比较两类符号的走向，发现产业带基本沿铁路等主要交通干线展开，因此回答造成长条状分布的最主要原因是主要交通线走向。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中我国西部地区的综合产业带以黑色或阴影斑块表示，整体不是大面积均匀铺开，而是呈细长的串珠状分布。例如北部沿天山北麓、兰新线附近延伸；中部在兰州—关中等方向呈带状；西南部沿成都—重庆—贵阳—昆明等方向延伸。图中同时标注了多条交通干线，如兰新线、陇海线、宝成铁路、成昆铁路、川黔线、贵昆线等。再推理：这些产业带的延伸方向与铁路等主要交通干线的走向基本一致，说明产业布局主要依托交通线展开。因此，产业带呈长条状分布的最主要原因是主要交通线的走向。
